sources.title: Live updates: Bitcoin steadies near $84,000 as the bond selloff pauses
Bitcoin Stalls Near $84,000 Amid Bitget Hack and Surging Treasury Yields
Bitcoin Dips Below $85,000 as 10-Year Treasury Yield Surpasses 5% on Hot Economic Data
Binance Sees Largest Bitcoin Outflow Since 2023 as BTC Trades Near $85K
Bitcoin edges lower as odds of October Fed rate hike jump to 75 percent

verified_facts: BTC-USD traded ~$84,000 on Sep 25, flat over 24h after falling below $84k on Wed; 24h range $82,900–$84,900 (CoinDesk, DailyCoin)

Bitget disclosed ~$351.6M security breach (hot + cold wallets), suspended withdrawals; CEO Gracy Chen said potential links to North Korean hacking group; losses covered by $464M user protection fund (TrustFinance)
US 10Y Treasury yield surpassed 5% for first time since 2007, driven by hotter-than-expected Sep PMI data (S&P Global: business activity suggesting ~5% annualized growth, Q3 GDP ~4%) (TrustFinance)
Crypto liquidations totaled $510M over 24h across 122,256 traders; longs $363.83M, shorts $77.43M; hourly post-PMI: $135.8M liquidations, $125.9M long (TrustFinance)
CME FedWatch: Oct rate hike probability ~75%, Dec ~59%; Fed hiked 25bps to 3.75-4% on Sep 16, dot plot median 4.1% through 2027 (DigitalToday)
Binance BTC outflow: 13,800 BTC single-day (Sep 25), reserves fell 705k→685k BTC over 4 days; largest daily outflow since 2023 (DailyCoin)
Deribit: ~$14B in BTC options expiring Friday Sep 26, large call block below $85k strike (CoinDesk)
BTC spot ETFs: $190.65M net inflows on Sep 24 (lowest in 5 days vs $998.9M on Sep 22); cumulative 2026 net inflows turned positive ~$320M for first time (DailyCoin, DigitalToday)
interpretation: BTC is in a technical correction after failing to hold $85k, pressured by surging yields (10Y >5%), hawkish Fed expectations (75% Oct hike odds), and the Bitget hack spooking sentiment. The $84k level is a key pivot — Deribit expiry and ETF flows will decide direction. Outflows from Binance suggest retail FOMO accumulation rather than exchange risk.
contradictions: CoinDesk says BTC 'flat over 24h' while TrustFinance reports BTC fell 0.1% to $83,999.6 — minor discrepancy likely due to snapshot timing
DailyCoin says BTC up 1.5% over 24h per CoinGecko vs CoinDesk 'flat over 24h' — possible difference between spot and derivatives pricing
unknowns: Exact Deribit expiry payout outcome (options settle Friday Sep 26)
Bitget hack full forensic report — perpetrator not definitively identified
Whether Sep 25 PMI data revision or additional economic prints will shift Fed odds further
BTC ETF inflow trajectory for Sep 25 (only Sep 22 and Sep 24 data available)
recommended_lead_action: Monitor $84k support ahead of Deribit expiry; watch 10Y yield (5% is key resistance); Bitget hack fallout may trigger further risk-off — size positions accordingly. Next data point: US GDP print and Oct 27-28 FOMC.
